stills.alt: Step 1 · Open the app. No account to make. Pick kg or lb. Or tap Skip. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Optional. Your numbers are all optional. Bar, experience, bodyweight. Skip it. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · One tap. One tap is required. Age 16 or older, or a guardian agrees. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Train. Straight to Train. Nothing to enter. No sign in. No permission pop-ups. Screen from the app.
Log and history. Log every set. Keep the history. Your Log Book, free. Screen from the app.
Daily workout. A workout built around your day. Build My Workout, free. Screen from the app.
A full program. Beginner Foundation, ten weeks. A full program, free. Screen from the app.
PR Tracker. Every PR, tracked. Your total, lift by lift. Screen from the app.
Calculators. Percentages, plates, 1RM, kg and lb. The Tools tab, free. Screen from the app.
Learn the Lifts. Learn the lifts, step by step. Snatch, clean and jerk. Screen from the app.
Bar Trace. Three bar path analyses a month. Free, with no sensor. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · Set card. One set at a time. Built big. Weight, set count and your cue. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Plates. Plates worked out for you. 98 kg exact, shown per side. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Made. Made it? One tap. The next set loads up a step. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Miss. Missed it? Tag it and go on. Call the miss. Get the drills. Screen from the app.
Rest timer. Rest starts on its own. Tap Made. The countdown begins. Screen from the app.
Your call. Need more time? Add 30 seconds. Reset it, or skip the rest. Screen from the app.
Call the miss. Missed it? Tag why. In front, behind, press-out, drop. Screen from the app.
The fix. Causes, drills and a cue. Matched to the tag you picked. Screen from the app.
Accessibility view. The set goes huge. Big numbers. Big Made and Miss. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · Check in. Tell it how you feel. Energy, sore muscles and time. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Your session. A session built around you. Sore muscles avoided. Sets and time shown. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Dial it. Dial any block up or down. Light, Normal or Heavy. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Train. Plates worked out for you. One set at a time. No program needed. Screen from the app.
Save as routine. Keep the workout you built. It waits in My Programs, under Routines. Screen from the app.
Program Builder. Add a week. Add a day. Write a program week by week. Screen from the app.
Add exercises. Sets, reps and percent of your PR. Pick from the library. Load by percent. Screen from the app.
Run it. Name it. Your cycle joins the list. Preview it, then Start This Program. Screen from the app.
Share a program. Print it, or save it as a PDF. One tap from any program. Screen from the app.
Print preview. Every week, with your weights. Page 1 of 7 for Beginner Foundation. Screen from the app.
End a program. End it. The report opens right away. Records, ratios and bar speed. Screen from the app.
What to run next. It names what limited you. Then points to the next cycle. Screen from the app.
Start to end. Records and ratios, start against end. Bar speed too, when you film. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · The grade. One grade out of 100 for the lift. Pull under, bar path and rhythm. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · The rules. Checked against competition rules. Every rule listed with its number. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Not sure?. Can't see a rule? It says so. Graded on the bar alone. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · The lights. No clear view? No guess. It says Can't judge, not a guess. Screen from the app.
Share Video. Your lift, with the bar path burned in. Story or square, with a speed graph. Screen from the app.
Make it yours. Phase colors, your choice of stats. Weight, speed and path score on or off. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · Set up. Phone side-on, 3 to 5 m back. Whole lift in frame, head to feet. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Get the clip. Record it, or import the clip. Pick a clip from Photos and trim it. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · The plate. Circle one plate. It sets the scale and what to track. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Analyze. Every frame, read on your phone. Your clip stays on your device. Screen from the app.
Step 5 · Your results. A grade and a speed for every clip. Three analyses a month are free. Screen from the app.
Delayed Replay. Watch the rep you just lifted. A few seconds after. Nothing is recorded. Screen from the app.
Pick the delay. 3, 5, 8 or 10 seconds behind. The header shows how far behind you are. Screen from the app.
Hands off. Prop the phone up. Lift. Then look. Front or back camera. Screen from the app.
Data and Privacy. Sync clips to iCloud, or keep them local. Off, Wi-Fi only, or Wi-Fi and cellular. Screen from the app.
PR Tracker. Your total, always on top. Snatch plus clean and jerk. Screen from the app.
Every lift. Each lift, its best, and its trend. Primary and secondary lifts. Screen from the app.
Tap a lift. Tap one. See every PR. Your current best, over time. Screen from the app.
Calendar. Your month, at a glance. Trained, missed, scheduled. Screen from the app.
Reflections. Take stock of the last block. Sleep, fatigue, difficulty and more. Screen from the app.
Log a rep record. Log a double or a triple. Reps 2 to 5 are saved apart. Screen from the app.
Your 1RM stays put. It lands as a 3RM. Your 1RM holds. Percent prescriptions stay honest. Screen from the app.
Learn the Lifts. Snatch, clean and jerk, in the right order. Position, movement, speed, then weight. Screen from the app.
Every step. Know how to do it. Know when to move on. A how-to, plus a ready check. Screen from the app.
Your progress. Mark it done. The next step is up. Progress is saved. 1 of 12 done. Screen from the app.
Snatch, 12 steps. From an overhead hold to a full snatch. Clean has 9 steps. Jerk has 8. Screen from the app.
Technique Doctor. It reads your lifts and names the fault. From your bar traces and miss tags. Screen from the app.
The evidence. A cue for each fault, the clips behind it. Dates link to the lifts that show it. Screen from the app.
Browse all faults. Causes and drills, for any miss. Where to film it, too. Screen from the app.
Pro history. Free reads 5 lifts. Pro reads further back. So you can watch a fault shrink. Screen from the app.
Complex Builder. Pick a lift. See what fits next. Tools, Prep, Complex Builder. Screen from the app.
Every gap checked. Clean, front squat, power jerk. Floor to rack. Rack to overhead. Screen from the app.
Loading. The weakest lift sets the weight. Power Jerk limits this. 75% is 80 kg. Screen from the app.
Meet Day. Set your openers. Start the room. Snatch 96 kg. Clean and jerk 120 kg. Screen from the app.
Count attempts. Count the attempts before yours. Tap minus as each attempt happens. Screen from the app.
Warm-up card. A card says when to lift. Each set timed to the attempts out. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · Set the meet. Name it. Date it. Pick the priority. A, B or C meet, and a target class. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Blocks. Blocks, worked back from meet day. 109 days out: Strength to Competition Peak. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Taper. A taper, then a dress rehearsal. Collars on from 4 weeks. Meet jumps from 3. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Class limit. See the pace to your class limit. Planning guidance, not medical advice. Screen from the app.
Robi points. Your total against the world record. 227 kg is 62.2% of 365 kg: 229 points. Screen from the app.
Body. Log an injury. Pick a stage. Protect, Reintroduce or Rebuild. Screen from the app.
Your training. Your training works around it. Movements that load it are kept out. Screen from the app.
Not medical advice. It changes your training, not treatment. Cleared by a professional? Move on. Screen from the app.
The Help center. Short guides. One task each. Logging, workouts, Bar Trace and more. Screen from the app.
Search. Type a word. Find the section. Try export. Three guides come up. Screen from the app.
Step by step. Numbered steps. No guessing. Check weight and reps. Tap Made or Miss. Screen from the app.
Then do it. Then try it in the app. Log a set and the rest timer starts. Screen from the app.
Beginner Foundation. The free program for new lifters. 10 weeks, 3 days a week, 30 sessions. Screen from the app.
Preview it first. Read week one before you start. Every lift, set and percent listed. Screen from the app.
Easy on you. Intensity stays under 70%. Learn the positions. Build a base. Screen from the app.
Check in. One tap tells it how you feel. Fresh, Normal, Tired or Smoked. Screen from the app.
Weights adjust. Bad day? The weights back off. Tired eases 5%. Smoked eases 10%. Screen from the app.
Weak-point picks. It reads your own bar traces. Your recent lifts shape the session. Screen from the app.
Lab Notes. Every pick says why it is there. Seen in 4 recent lifts. Miss tags agree. Screen from the app.
Tap a note. Tap it. See the fix. A cue, and drills to fix it. Screen from the app.
What the trace says. One fault named. One cue to fix it. In plain words. Screen from the app.
Fix with. Drills to fix it, handed to you. Muscle, tall and scarecrow snatch. Screen from the app.
Sinclair. Your total, scored for your bodyweight. 1.3549 coefficient × 227 kg = 307.6 Screen from the app.
Change bodyweight. Same total, different score. 89 kg: 1.2088 × 227 kg = 274.4 Screen from the app.
Barbell Loader. Enter the weight. See the bar. 100 kg: 25 + 15 per side, exact. Screen from the app.
Your bar. Any jump, any bar. 103 kg on a 15 kg bar, exact. Screen from the app.
Log Book. Every session, newest first. Sets made, tonnage and time. Screen from the app.
Open a session. Tap in for every set. Weight and reps, set by set. Screen from the app.
Gains. Every set earns XP. Every level shows. 275 / 900 XP to level 4. Screen from the app.
How you earned it. See where the XP came from. Records, lifts analyzed, sessions and more. Screen from the app.
Streaks. Weekly streaks, perfect weeks. Tracked on the same screen. Screen from the app.
Badges. Milestones you can see and earn. Earned ones light up. Tap one for details. Screen from the app.
